metadata.description: Official bonez plugin for Cursor. The org context lake — knowledge graph, search, rules, and memories — over MCP.

plugins.name: bonez
plugins.description: Bring your organization's context lake into Cursor — org search across code, decisions, tickets, PRs, docs and people; graph-powered navigation (callers, blast radius, tests-for); standing org rules and durable memories over the bonez MCP, with an approval gate on memory/rules writes.
